sections.name: body
sections.value: PR 344 pass-with-notes (verdict dce112f). Authority check: grep role_type, of_role and meta[type] readers. Authority stays in seat_role_for (role id) and require_prime. Cost trap: /v1/seats is polled by federation fan-in at 1 s per peer, so anything added to the seats handler runs at that rate, not per pij list. Cheap mutation method: git archive HEAD | tar -x into mktemp, apply 3 independent mutations together with python asserts, run PIJ_SHARED_TARGET=<main>/target just shared-build -- test -p pij-daemon --lib community::. Each failure maps to one mutation, one build (~a few minutes), then rm the mktemp dir only.
